commits.author: StanGirard
commits.subject: fix(cloud-agent): fix infinite restart loop and CI/CD build order
commits.body:
- CI/CD: Docker image now builds after Release CLI workflow completes
- CI/CD: Add semantic version tags (v2.x.x) to Docker images
- Release: Add package.cloud.json and provisioning/package.json to PACKAGE_FILES
- Agent: Disable auto-update for cloud agents (CLOUD_AGENT=true env var)
- Provisioning: Use versioned image tags matching service version
- Update stale versions: package.cloud.json 2.8.1 → 2.12.0, provisioning 2.3.0 → 2.12.0

The root cause was that cloud agents had version 2.8.1 baked into the Docker
image while web was at 2.12.0. The auto-update mechanism tried to update via
npm install -g, which doesn't persist in Docker containers, causing an
infinite restart loop.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
